COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No.943 of 2024
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Prabhakar Joshi, learned counsel for the 
petitioner. 
2. Mr. Atul Bahuguna learned Standing Counsel for 
the State. 
3. Mr. Ashish Joshi, learned counsel for respondent 
no.2.
4. Petitioner has filed this petition challenging condition 
no.5 of order dated 17.05.2024 whereby candidature of 
petitioner was rejected mainly on the ground that 
petitioner has submitted permanent resident certificate 
dated 02.03.2024 which is issued after the last date of 
submission of application form i.e. 03.11.2023.
5. It is submitted by petitioner that he is a permanent 
resident of State of Uttarakhand and there is no such 
condition in the Resident advertisement that the 
permanent resident certificate submitted by petitioner 
shall be prior to the last date of submission of application 
form. 
6. Four weeks' time is given to respondents to file 
counter affidavit.
7. Rejoinder if any within two weeks thereafter.
8. List on 26.09.2024. 
9. As an interim measure, it is provided that one post of 
Junior Engineer (Electrical) shall be kept vacant for 
petitioner. 
10. Copy of this order be supplied to the learned 
counsel for the parties, today itself, as per rules.
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 12.06.2024
BS

Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Prabhakar Joshi, learned counsel for petitioner.
2. Mr. Devesh Ghildiyal, learned B.H. for the State.
3. Mr. Pankaj Miglani, learned counsel for respondent 
no.2, through video conferencing.
4. Learned counsel for the respondent no.2 seeks 
adjournment merely on the ground that he has been 
entrusted with the brief in the year 2025.
5. On perusal of the record, it transpires that the counter 
affidavit has been called from the respondent-Commission 
by this Court on 12.06.2024, but till date no counter 
affidavit has been filed.
6. In such view of the matter, respondent-Commission 
may file a counter affidavit subject to payment of ₹10,000/-
to be paid to the petitioner.
7. List this case on 04.11.2026.
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
